intro: Tunisia is a republic where power has become concentrated in the president since 2021.

chapters.title: How it works
text: President Kais Saied suspended parliament in 2021 and passed a new constitution in 2022 giving the president wide powers. Critics say democracy has gone backwards, and opponents have been jailed.

chapters.title: A democratic decade
text: From 2011 to 2021 Tunisia was the Arab Spring's only lasting democracy, with free elections.
